title_en: “The successful one raises his hand”: 2024 Preliminary Sixth Grade Results in Iraq, All Governorates, via the Natijatna Website
text_en: “The successful one raises his hand”: 2024 Preliminary Sixth Grade Results in Iraq, All Governorates, via the Natijatna Website “The successful one raises his hand” 2024 Preliminary Sixth Grade Results in Iraq, All Governorates, via the Natijatna Website 2024 Preliminary Sixth Grade Results 2024 Preliminary Sixth Grade Results, A state of anxiety and tension has begun to appear among a large number of students recently, specifically after the Iraqi Ministry of Education announced the completion of uploading students’ results to the ministry’s official website. The Ministry also indicated on its official page that students had finished the first-round exams at the end of January 2024, and that the Ministry had begun following up on the correction and review work so that it could announce the results on the official date. The preliminary sixth grade stage is one of the most important educational stages, as it determines the student’s fate. Through this article, we will learn together about the link for checking the 2024 preliminary sixth grade results. 2024 Preliminary Sixth Grade Results The Iraqi Ministry of Education announced that the 2024 preliminary sixth grade results had become available to students starting early in the morning of Thursday, 15 February 2024. The Ministry noted that it was keen to follow up on the correction and review work in all the controls, to make sure justice and transparency are achieved among students. The Iraqi Minister of Education added that students can check the preliminary sixth grade results in Iraq by following these steps: Link for checking the 2024 preliminary sixth grade results - First, visit the official website of the Iraqi Ministry of Education online. - Or the Natijatna website. - Enter the visual verification code shown on the screen in front of you. - Press the preliminary first-round exam results. - Enter the student’s registration number. - Then press the “Show Result” icon. - The student’s result in all subjects will appear in front of you.

title_en: Don’t Cook Broth Without These Spices: It Will Turn Out Bland and Tasteless
text_en: Don’t cook broth without these spices: it will turn out bland and tasteless Homemade broth seems like a simple dish, but it is exactly where flavor most often falls short. Even good-quality meat and vegetables do not guarantee a rich result without the right spices. A few well-chosen seasonings can completely change the aroma and make the broth truly homemade. It is important not to complicate the recipe, but to know the basic combinations. They are what build depth of flavor from the first minutes of cooking. The FoodOboz editorial team will explain which spices are best to add to soup so the dish is truly tasty. Why broth turns out bland The main mistake is limiting yourself to salt alone or adding spices only at the end. Broth needs an aroma that gradually unfolds during slow cooking. If the seasonings are chosen incorrectly or there are too few of them, the liquid will remain “empty” in taste. Spices are what create that familiar smell associated with homemade soup. Basic spices without which broth will not work Bay leaf is the foundation of classic broth. It gives a deep, recognizable aroma and makes the flavor rounder. One or two leaves are enough so as not to overload the dish. Salt and black pepper are mandatory, but the timing of adding them matters. Whole peppercorns are better added at the start of cooking so the aroma has time to open up, and salt closer to the end so the flavor is balanced. Clove is a spice that is often overlooked. In small amounts it strengthens the broth’s flavor and pairs well with bay leaf, making the aroma warmer and richer. Spices that add character to broth Lovage has a bright, expressive flavor that is familiar in home cooking. It is added in very small amounts, but it is exactly what makes the broth aromatic and recognizable. Parsley, fresh or dried, refreshes the flavor and adds a light herbal note. It can be added both during cooking and at the end. Dried vegetables – carrot, celery, parsnip – enhance the taste and give the broth an appealing color. They work well in meat, chicken or vegetable broths alike. How to add spices correctly To make broth aromatic, it is better to add spices at the start or in the middle of cooking. The heat should be minimal, without active boiling, so that the aroma opens up gradually. An excess of seasonings can spoil the taste, so it is important to keep things simple and moderate. title_en: Another Movie with Ram Charan.. A Story Beyond Your Imagination.. It Will Blast: Director Buchibabu of ‘Peddi’
text_en: Another movie with Ram Charan.. A story beyond your imagination.. It will blast: Director Buchibabu of ‘Peddi’ Buchibabu Sana, a disciple of Sukumar who was introduced as a director with the film ‘Uppena’ in 2021, is coming before audiences with his second film after five years. The film ‘Peddi’, which he directed with Ram Charan as the hero, is ready for release. It will hit theaters worldwide on a large scale on June 4. In this context, director Buchibabu is giving a series of interviews and sharing several interesting things as part of them. He announced that he will make another film with Cherry. Buchibabu said that Ram Charan worked very hard for the film ‘Peddi’, and that Chiranjeevi also could not stay on the sets for long because he could not bear to watch Charan’s struggle. He said Charan had told him he would do a film only if he liked the story, and that when the story was told, he agreed right away. He said he had also narrated this story to Chiranjeevi, and that it was a great experience. ''Chiranjeevi also came to the ‘Peddi’ sets. At that time, the wrestling competition scene was being shot. Seeing Charan’s struggle in the sun, he could not stay for more than an hour and a half. Unable to watch it, he left from there,'' Buchibabu said. When asked about a memorable moment on the ‘Peddi’ set, Buchibabu said that Ram Charan had seated him close by and fed him rice, and that he would never forget it. ''Charan asked me, ‘You are working so hard... what do you want?’ I said, ‘I want to direct you again, sir.’ He also agreed.'' Thus, he revealed that another film would come from the combination of the two after ‘Peddi’. ''I have an idea of what kind of film to make with Charan this time. Charan knows it too. He himself will tell you. I am telling you truly... what it is won’t even be within your imagination. It will blast. I believe in that idea very strongly. If God makes ‘Peddi’ a success, then let’s look into that,'' Buchibabu said. Mega fans have huge expectations for the film ‘Peddi’. The promotional content already released has greatly impressed them. That is why they want another movie in the Buchibabu–Cherry combination even before this film is released.

title_en: They Set a Quantum Computing Record! The Behind-the-Scenes of This Success Is Impressive
text_en: They set a quantum computing record! The behind-the-scenes of this success is impressive The result alone can be stunning, and it gets even more interesting when we realize it was achieved using existing silicon chips. Available semiconductor infrastructure made it possible to maintain 99.9% stability of the qubit, that is, the quantum bit, on a device used for quantum processing. Also read: Musk prepares a rival for ChatGPT and Google. Supercomputer will create the Grok 2 model Qubits differ from classical bits in their ability to take not only the state 0 or 1, but both at the same time. But appropriate technologies are needed to fully exploit this undoubted potential. Representatives of Diraq took up exactly this issue. They worked on a 300-millimeter silicon wafer and made progress that should allow advanced quantum calculations to be performed using existing semiconductors. According to the researchers themselves, a result of 99.9% is sufficient for full-scale quantum processors adapted for error correction. Such components are manufactured in existing factories that produce silicon chips. Interestingly, the success might not have happened without cooperation with the Belgian research center Imec. It was its engineers who designed the qubit device used in the tests. Circuits such as the one above allow quantum calculations to be performed with very high accuracy. One aspect of the undertaking was combining silicon qubit devices. Such integration should increase the number of qubits in the circuit – results exceeding a million quantum bits are being talked about! Combining with CMOS transistors is important because the latter are produced for mobile devices and cloud-based infrastructure. Also read: The quantum battery impresses not only with its capacity. It is a project by Polish scientists Combining qubits with CMOS transistors on a single silicon chip enables miniaturization. This makes it possible to avoid large and costly components with high energy demands. In the long term, the progress made should bring a range of benefits in fields connected with everyday life. We can imagine, for example, designing new drugs or materials with previously unseen properties.

title_en: The Last Friendly Match of GKS Katowice and Raków Częstochowa. A Surprising Course of the Match Before the Cups
text_en: The last friendly match of GKS Katowice and Raków Częstochowa. A surprising course of the match before the cups GKS Katowice’s preparations for the cups The friendly that ended the summer preparations finished in a 1:1 draw between GKS Katowice and Raków Częstochowa. The first half ended goalless. The lead for the hosts was taken by Eman Markovic in the 54th minute. The final result was set by a header from Adam Basse in the 85th minute. It was the final test of form for both Ekstraklasa teams. The team of coach Rafał Górak had earlier trained during a training camp in Opalenica. There, the Katowice side beat Świt Szczecin 7:0 and Arka Gdynia 2:0. The team also suffered a one-goal defeat against Piast Gliwice. Later it won 2:0 against Miedź Legnica, and just after returning home it beat Stal Rzeszów 3:1. Where did Raków Częstochowa polish its form? Before the start of the season, the side from under Jasna Góra went to a training camp in the Netherlands. In friendlies there it recorded defeats to Belgian SV Zulte Waregem 3:4 and Greek runners-up Olympiakos Piraeus 1:2. It then drew 2:2 with Dutch champions PSV Eindhoven under coach Dawid Kroczek’s charge. Even before leaving for that foreign camp, the Częstochowa side had won 2:0 at home against Piast Gliwice. Both teams are currently preparing for competition in the Conference League qualifiers. GKS returns to European cups after 23 years and will play in the second round against the loser of the Hajduk Split – MSK Żylina tie. The Częstochowa side, in turn, will host Maltese FC Valetta in the fight for the next stage. The matches of the two Polish teams in this competition are scheduled for 23 July.
